name: Sun-Earth Realistic Profile (2026-04-20 TDB)
description: Sun-Earth 2D initial state based on JPL Solar System Dynamics approximate planetary elements for the Earth-Moon barycenter, evaluated at epoch 2026-04-20 00:00:00 TDB and converted into a Sun-Earth barycentric two-body state.
notes: This is a realistic 2D Sun-Earth initial condition for the simulator, not a full n-body ephemeris.
The simulator itself is two-body, so Moon and planetary perturbations are not included after t=0.
The in-plane state is derived from JPL's published approximate planetary elements and JPL astrodynamic constants.
